meta.label: MEASURED — building density within 10km of each branch (Overture footprints)
meta.provenance: source-data/perimeter_counts.json, perimeter 3D audit workflow (wf_127c1b1e-038), counts computed from the 77 real Overture catchment files (3 in-repo + 74 on the operator R2 CDN). Method: per province: bin catchment building centroids into 0.1-degree grid; count within 10km of each branch; branch->province by Thai name join
caveats: MEASURED — building count within 10km (equirect) of each branch, from the capped (180k/province) catchment pulls. A zero means the CAPPED file has no buildings there, NOT that the area is empty on the ground.

perimeter_counts.json predates the branches_fingerprint convention and carries no per-record identity field; index alignment against the CURRENT branches.json was manually verified (fingerprint continuity since commit dda7816, 2026-07-02) before this builder was written — see docs/DATA_REFRESH_LOG.md.
